title: Buy PPL
lead: Pay with USDC or USDT on Base, or from other chains with the built-in automatic swap widget. PPL is recorded to your address in the sale contract on Base and becomes native PPL on the PEOPLE network at genesis.
networksList: Base (USDC/USDT); other chains via automatic swap, including Tron and Solana; TON is not supported
salePayBody: The sale runs on Base only (one sale contract on Base). Pay with USDC or USDT on Base, or with USDT/USDC from other chains, including Tron and Solana, via the built-in automatic swap widget, which converts to USDC on Base. TON is not supported.
unavailable: This network is not open yet.
